title: Strategy Envying Context parameters
pattern: An external calculation strategy struct queries multiple instance variables from the context class (`Loan`) to compute a single business metric.
why_bad: It exposes context variables publicly, breaking encapsulation. The strategy is so tightly coupled to the internal fields of the context that any changes to those fields require rewriting the strategy class.
detection: Strategy classes whose methods accept a context object and perform calculations using three or more fields of that context.
counterexample: Strategies that act as generic operators (e.g., standard comparison functions).
source: Joshua Kerievsky, *Refactoring to Patterns* (2004), Chapter 4 ("Move Embellishment to Decorator").
